description: Run the logic tests in tests/**/*.test.ts (keiko): the real game in Node, no browser, in milliseconds. Each failure has its message, the source line, and the game's tick, scene and state when it failed. After each edit pass `changed: true`: only the tests whose code or files changed since they last passed run, and `due` says why each one did. Run everything once when the work is done. One test per mechanic: search tests/ first; fixes, tweaks and fuzz replays go into the existing test.

changed.description: Only run tests whose code or files changed since they last passed, plus new and failed ones.

files.description: Test files relative to the root. Default: all.

filter.description: Only run tests whose name contains this text.

root.description: Project root. Absolute path, or relative to the server's root. Default: the server's root.

name: run_tests
title: Run logic tests
